questions.subject: D
questions.questionText: Convert the fraction 3/8 into a decimal:
questions.explanation: 3 ÷ 8 = 0.375. 0.325 is wrong (that is 13/40); 0.385 is wrong (that is 77/200); 0.350 is wrong (that is 7/20).

questions.subject: D
questions.questionText:
Consider the following statements about decimal fractions:

(i) 0.5 is equivalent to the fraction 1/2.
(ii) 0.25 is equivalent to the fraction 1/4.
(iii) 0.33 is exactly equal to the fraction 1/3.
(iv) 0.125 is equivalent to the fraction 1/8.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explanation: 0.5 = 1/2 (i-correct); 0.25 = 1/4 (ii-correct); 0.125 = 1/8 (iv-correct). Statement (iii) is wrong because 1/3 = 0.3333... (recurring), not exactly 0.33. 0.33 = 33/100, which is only an approximation of 1/3.

questions.subject: D
questions.questionText: What is the value of 2.45 + 3.678?
questions.explanation: 2.45 + 3.678 = 2.450 + 3.678 = 6.128. 6.028 is wrong (subtraction error); 5.128 is wrong (misplaced digit); 5.928 is wrong (wrong carry).

questions.subject: D
questions.questionText:
Given below are two statements, one labeled as Assertion (A) and the other as Reason (R).

Assertion (A): 0.999... (recurring) is exactly equal to 1.
Reason (R): The difference between 1 and 0.999... is infinitely small (zero), making them mathematically identical.

Choose the correct option:
options: Both (A) and (R) are correct and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)
Both (A) and (R) are correct but (R) is NOT the correct explanation of (A)
(A) is correct but (R) is not correct
(A) is not correct but (R) is correct
questions.correctAnswer: Both (A) and (R) are correct and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)
questions.explanation: 0.999... = 1 is a proven mathematical fact (A is correct). The difference 1 − 0.999... = 0, making them identical (R is correct and explains A). Option 2 is wrong because R directly explains A; Option 3 is wrong because R is mathematically correct; Option 4 is wrong because A is also correct.

questions.subject: D
questions.questionText:
Which of the following are terminating decimals?

(i) 1/4
(ii) 1/3
(iii) 7/8
(iv) 5/6

Select the correct combination:
questions.explanation: A fraction in lowest terms gives a terminating decimal only if the denominator has no prime factors other than 2 and 5. 1/4 = 0.25 (i-correct, denom = 2²); 7/8 = 0.875 (iii-correct, denom = 2³). 1/3 (ii) is wrong — denom has factor 3, giving 0.333...; 5/6 (iv) is wrong — denom has factor 3, giving 0.8333...

questions.subject: D
questions.questionText:
Match the following fractions with their decimal equivalents:

Column I:
(a) 3/4
(b) 2/5
(c) 5/8
(d) 1/6

Column II:
(i) 0.4
(ii) 0.1666...
(iii) 0.625
(iv) 0.75

Choose the correct match:
questions.explanation: 3/4 = 0.75 (a-iv); 2/5 = 0.4 (b-i); 5/8 = 0.625 (c-iii); 1/6 = 0.1666... (d-ii). Option 2 wrongly assigns 0.625 to 3/4; Option 3 swaps 2/5 and 5/8 values; Option 4 swaps 5/8 and 1/6 values.

questions.subject: D
questions.questionText: Arrange the following in ascending order: 0.45, 0.405, 0.4, 0.45̄ (0.4555...)
questions.explanation: Converting to same decimal places: 0.4 = 0.400, 0.405 = 0.405, 0.45 = 0.450, 0.45̄ = 0.4555... Ascending: 0.400 < 0.405 < 0.450 < 0.4555... Option 2 wrongly places 0.405 before 0.4; Option 3 wrongly places 0.45 before 0.405; Option 4 wrongly orders all.

questions.subject: D
questions.questionText:
Consider the following statements:

(i) To multiply a decimal by 10, move the decimal point one place to the right.
(ii) To divide a decimal by 100, move the decimal point two places to the left.
(iii) 0.07 × 1000 = 70.
(iv) 45.6 ÷ 10 = 0.456.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explanation: Moving decimal right by 1 for ×10 (i-correct); moving left by 2 for ÷100 (ii-correct); 0.07 × 1000 = 70 (iii-correct). Statement (iv) is wrong because 45.6 ÷ 10 = 4.56, not 0.456 (that would be ÷100).

questions.subject: D
questions.questionText: What is the value of 0.36 expressed as a fraction in its simplest form?
questions.explanation: 0.36 = 36/100. Simplifying: 36/100 ÷ 4/4 = 9/25. 36/100 is wrong — not in simplest form; 18/50 is wrong — also not simplified (= 9/25); 6/15 is wrong — 6/15 = 0.4, not 0.36.

questions.subject: D
questions.questionText:
Given below are two statements, one labeled as Assertion (A) and the other as Reason (R).

Assertion (A): The decimal expansion of 1/7 is non-terminating and recurring.
Reason (R): A rational number whose denominator (in lowest terms) has prime factors other than 2 and 5 always gives a non-terminating recurring decimal.

Choose the correct option:
options: Both (A) and (R) are correct and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)
Both (A) and (R) are correct but (R) is NOT the correct explanation of (A)
(A) is correct but (R) is not correct
(A) is not correct but (R) is correct
questions.correctAnswer: Both (A) and (R) are correct and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)
questions.explanation: 1/7 = 0.142857142857... which is non-terminating and recurring (A is correct). The denominator 7 has a prime factor other than 2 and 5, so it gives a recurring decimal (R is correct and explains A). Option 2 is wrong because R directly explains why 1/7 is recurring; Option 3 is wrong because R is a valid mathematical rule; Option 4 is wrong because A is factually correct.

questions.subject: D
questions.questionText: Simplify: 0.008 ÷ 0.04
questions.explanation: 0.008 ÷ 0.04 = 8/1000 ÷ 4/100 = 8/1000 × 100/4 = 800/4000 = 0.2. Or: 0.008/0.04 = 8/40 = 0.2. 0.02 is wrong (divides incorrectly); 2.0 is wrong (multiplies instead of dividing); 0.002 is wrong (moves decimal wrong way).

questions.subject: D
questions.questionText: If 4.5 × a = 9.0, what is the value of a?

questions.subject: D
questions.questionText:
Consider the following statements about recurring decimals:

(i) 1/7 = 0.142857142857... has a period of 6 digits.
(ii) 1/11 = 0.090909... has a period of 2 digits.
(iii) Every recurring decimal can be expressed as a fraction.
(iv) 1/9 = 0.111... has a period of 3 digits.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explanation: 1/7 = 0.1̄4̄2̄8̄5̄7̄ repeats every 6 digits (i-correct); 1/11 = 0.0̄9̄ repeats every 2 digits (ii-correct); every recurring decimal is rational and can be written as p/q (iii-correct). Statement (iv) is wrong because 1/9 = 0.1̄ has a period of 1 digit (just '1' repeating), not 3.

questions.subject: D
questions.questionText: What is the product of 1.2 × 0.5 × 0.3?

questions.questionText: Fill in the blank: The decimal equivalent of the fraction 7/20 is __________.

questions.subject: D
questions.questionText: A shopkeeper sells an item for Rs. 12.50 per piece. If a customer buys 8 pieces, what is the total cost?
questions.explanation: Total = 12.50 × 8 = 100.00. Rs. 96 is wrong (uses 12 × 8); Rs. 104 is wrong (uses 13 × 8); Rs. 98 is wrong (uses 12.25 × 8).

questions.subject: D
questions.questionText:
Given below are two statements, one labeled as Assertion (A) and the other as Reason (R).

Assertion (A): 0.2 × 0.3 = 0.06, not 0.6.
Reason (R): When multiplying decimals, the number of decimal places in the product equals the sum of decimal places in both factors.

Choose the correct option:
options: Both (A) and (R) are correct and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)
Both (A) and (R) are correct but (R) is NOT the correct explanation of (A)
(A) is correct but (R) is not correct
(A) is not correct but (R) is correct
questions.correctAnswer: Both (A) and (R) are correct and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)
questions.explanation: 0.2 × 0.3 = 0.06 (A is correct — 1 decimal place + 1 decimal place = 2 decimal places in product). R correctly states the rule that explains why the product has 2 decimal places. Option 2 is wrong because R directly explains A; Option 3 is wrong because R is a valid rule; Option 4 is wrong because A is correct.

questions.subject: D
questions.questionText:
Consider the following statements:

(i) The place value of 5 in 3.056 is 5/100.
(ii) The place value of 7 in 0.307 is 7/1000.
(iii) The place value of 4 in 12.4 is 4/10.
(iv) The place value of 9 in 0.9 is 9/100.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explanation: In 3.056, the 5 is in hundredths place = 5/100 (i-correct); in 0.307, the 7 is in thousandths place = 7/1000 (ii-correct); in 12.4, the 4 is in tenths place = 4/10 (iii-correct). Statement (iv) is wrong because in 0.9, the 9 is in the tenths place = 9/10, not 9/100.

questions.subject: D
questions.explanation: 5.600 − 2.847 = 2.753. 2.853 is wrong (subtracts only 2.747); 2.653 is wrong (subtracts 2.947); 2.953 is wrong (subtracts 2.647).

questions.subject: D
questions.questionText:
Given below are two statements, one labeled as Assertion (A) and the other as Reason (R).

Assertion (A): To divide a number by 0.5 is the same as multiplying it by 2.
Reason (R): Dividing by a fraction is equivalent to multiplying by its reciprocal, and the reciprocal of 0.5 is 2.

Choose the correct option:
options: Both (A) and (R) are correct and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)
Both (A) and (R) are correct but (R) is NOT the correct explanation of (A)
(A) is correct but (R) is not correct
(A) is not correct but (R) is correct
questions.correctAnswer: Both (A) and (R) are correct and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)
questions.explanation: Dividing by 0.5 gives the same result as multiplying by 2 (A is correct, e.g., 10 ÷ 0.5 = 20 = 10 × 2). The reciprocal of 0.5 is 2, and dividing by a number equals multiplying by its reciprocal (R is correct and explains A). Option 2 is wrong because R directly explains A; Option 3 is wrong because R is correct; Option 4 is wrong because A is correct.

questions.subject: D
questions.questionText: A piece of rope is 8.4 m long. If it is cut into pieces of 0.7 m each, how many pieces will there be?
questions.explanation: Number of pieces = 8.4 ÷ 0.7 = 84/7 = 12. 10 is wrong (uses 8.4 ÷ 0.84); 11 is wrong (calculation error); 14 is wrong (uses 8.4 ÷ 0.6).

questions.subject: D
questions.questionText:
Match the following decimal operations with their results:

Column I:
(a) 0.1 × 0.1
(b) 0.1 + 0.1
(c) 0.1 ÷ 0.1
(d) 1 − 0.1

Column II:
(i) 0.2
(ii) 1.0
(iii) 0.01
(iv) 0.9

Choose the correct match:
questions.explanation: 0.1 × 0.1 = 0.01 (a-iii); 0.1 + 0.1 = 0.2 (b-i); 0.1 ÷ 0.1 = 1.0 (c-ii); 1 − 0.1 = 0.9 (d-iv). Option 2 swaps (a) and (b); Option 3 swaps (c) and (d); Option 4 swaps (b) and (c) wrongly.

questions.subject: D
questions.questionText: What is the value of 0.07 + 0.007 + 0.0007?
questions.explanation: 0.07 + 0.007 + 0.0007 = 0.0700 + 0.0070 + 0.0007 = 0.0777. 0.7777 is wrong (misplaces all values); 0.777 is wrong (uses 0.7 + 0.07 + 0.007); 0.077 is wrong (only adds first two).

questions.subject: D
questions.questionText:
Consider the following statements:

(i) 0.5̄ (0.555...) = 5/9.
(ii) 0.1̄2̄ (0.121212...) = 12/99 = 4/33.
(iii) 0.3̄ (0.333...) = 1/3.
(iv) 0.9̄ (0.999...) = 9/10.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explanation: 0.555... = 5/9 (i-correct); 0.121212... = 12/99 = 4/33 (ii-correct); 0.333... = 1/3 (iii-correct). Statement (iv) is wrong because 0.999... = 1 (not 9/10). 9/10 = 0.9 (terminating), not 0.999...

questions.subject: D
questions.questionText:
The following table shows prices per kg of items:

| Item | Price per kg (Rs.) |
|------|-------------------|
| Sugar | 45.50 |
| Rice | 62.75 |
| Dal | 98.25 |
| Flour | 35.80 |

If a person buys 2 kg of sugar and 1 kg of dal, what is the total cost?
questions.explanation: 2 kg sugar = 2 × 45.50 = Rs. 91.00. 1 kg dal = Rs. 98.25. Total = 91.00 + 98.25 = Rs. 189.25. Rs. 191.25 is wrong (uses 46.50 for sugar); Rs. 185.75 is wrong (uses 43.75 for sugar); Rs. 193.25 is wrong (uses 47.50 for sugar).

questions.subject: D
questions.questionText: Fill in the blank: If 2.5 × __________ = 1, then the blank is filled with the decimal value __________.

questions.subject: D
questions.questionText:
Which of the following are equal to 3/4?

(i) 0.75
(ii) 75%
(iii) 0.34 + 0.41
(iv) 1.5 ÷ 2

Select the correct combination:
questions.explanation: 0.75 = 3/4 (i-correct); 75% = 75/100 = 3/4 (ii-correct); 0.34 + 0.41 = 0.75 = 3/4 (iii-correct); 1.5 ÷ 2 = 0.75 = 3/4 (iv-correct). All four expressions equal 3/4.

questions.subject: D
questions.questionText: Simplify: (3.5)² − (2.5)²
questions.explanation: Using a² − b² = (a+b)(a−b): (3.5+2.5)(3.5−2.5) = 6.0 × 1.0 = 6.0. Alternatively: 12.25 − 6.25 = 6.0. 5.0 is wrong; 4.0 is wrong; 7.0 is wrong.

questions.subject: D
questions.questionText:
The following table shows distances (in km) covered by a vehicle on different days:

| Day | Distance (km) |
|-----|---------------|
| Monday | 45.6 |
| Tuesday | 52.3 |
| Wednesday | 38.75 |
| Thursday | 61.45 |

What is the total distance covered in these four days?
questions.explanation: 45.6 + 52.3 + 38.75 + 61.45 = 198.10 km. 197.10 is wrong (subtracts 1 from total); 196.10 is wrong (subtracts 2); 199.10 is wrong (adds 1 extra).

questions.subject: D
questions.questionText:
Match the following percentages with their decimal equivalents:

Column I:
(a) 12.5%
(b) 37.5%
(c) 6.25%
(d) 87.5%

Column II:
(i) 0.375
(ii) 0.0625
(iii) 0.875
(iv) 0.125

Choose the correct match:
questions.explanation: 12.5% = 0.125 (a-iv); 37.5% = 0.375 (b-i); 6.25% = 0.0625 (c-ii); 87.5% = 0.875 (d-iii). Option 2 swaps (a) and (b); Option 3 swaps (b) and (c); Option 4 swaps (c) and (d).

questions.subject: D
questions.questionText: What is the least number that must be added to 0.473 to make it exactly 0.5?
questions.explanation: Required = 0.500 − 0.473 = 0.027. 0.037 is wrong (would give 0.510); 0.017 is wrong (would give 0.490); 0.127 is wrong (would give 0.600).

questions.subject: D
questions.questionText:
Consider the following statements:

(i) 0.6 × 0.6 × 0.6 = 0.216.
(ii) √0.04 = 0.2.
(iii) √0.0009 = 0.03.
(iv) 0.3 × 0.3 = 0.9.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explanation: 0.6³ = 0.216 (i-correct); √0.04 = 0.2 (ii-correct, since 0.2² = 0.04); √0.0009 = 0.03 (iii-correct, since 0.03² = 0.0009). Statement (iv) is wrong because 0.3 × 0.3 = 0.09, not 0.9.

questions.subject: D
questions.questionText:
The following table shows the marks obtained (out of 10) by five students:

| Student | Marks |
|---------|-------|
| A | 7.5 |
| B | 8.25 |
| C | 6.75 |
| D | 9.0 |
| E | 7.0 |

What is the average marks of all five students?
questions.explanation: Sum = 7.5 + 8.25 + 6.75 + 9.0 + 7.0 = 38.50. Average = 38.50 ÷ 5 = 7.70. 7.50 is wrong (divides 37.5 by 5); 7.90 is wrong (divides 39.5 by 5); 8.10 is wrong (divides 40.5 by 5).
